title: A small site (up to six pages)
summary: A small website of up to six linked pages, built from your brand kit and your own pictures.

asks.label: Which pages? Up to six, one per line, such as Home, Projects, About, Contact:
Which pictures, by name, from your files?
Which company file holds the facts?

takes.label: Make a small site that learns from this

text: Make a small site with these pages, at most six, each linked from every other: [pages]. The first is the home page. Build it as a static site of HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript, from the brand kit and the site kit only: no package, and nothing fetched from anywhere. Copy these pictures from the company's files into the site: [pictures]. Take every fact from the company's files and invent none; read this one first: [facts]. Look at every version through the page viewer at phone and desktop width and fix what it shows, at most three times, before you report. Nothing is published; the owner picks a version. If I name research notes here, learn from their layout and examples and copy none of them: [research]
